svg.title: TotemOps voxel Minecraft troubleshooting illustration
svg.desc: Original voxel art inspired by block-building games: pixel clouds, grass and dirt cubes, block trees, a small house, a Minecraft server, and a read-only diagnosis panel demonstrating Waystones and Balm dependencies. This is not a real game screenshot.
svg.text: Original voxel illustration / 方塊風格原創示意圖 · not a gameplay screenshot
